subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept an npm postinstall loopback probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as one advisory mitigation layer for stale gateway imports?
rationale: The code path is mechanically coherent, but install-time network probing, a new environment surface, and overlap with the update-CLI warning PR are product and operator-experience choices rather than defects automation can settle.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review while leaving the broader stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Full Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for a packaged update or rollback run with an already-running gateway before accepting the install-time probe.

options.title: Pause For One Recovery Layer
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want the update CLI or runtime stale-import handling to be the only warning and recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review while leaving the broader stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.
